exposure: Gestational diabetes mellitus (GDM) diagnosis based on NICE and IADPSG criteria
GDM diagnosis based on NICE and IADPSG criteria
finding: Women who screened negative for GDM by NICE criteria but positive by IADPSG criteria had a higher risk of LGA infants, Cesarean delivery, and polyhydramnios, suggesting that the IADPSG criteria might identify women at risk who would be missed by NICE criteria.
birth_weight: Birthweight above the 90th percentile for gestational age (LGA)
